checks.finding: All five tasks are Risk: high with rationales naming sensitive surfaces (CLI/permission enforcement, input admission and reservation ordering, frozen-input hash normalization, protected entrypoint membership). T-004 (CI/regression wiring) is the closest to over-classification, but its Risk Rationale ties it to mandatory regression registration of the protection inventory (TEST-013), so the tier is defensible. Advisory only.

Every high task's Done When requires recording RED-to-GREEN regressions with exact hashes (T-001..T-005) and independent diff review plus formal quality evaluation with no blocking findings. No task is Risk: critical, so second-approver and signed-bundle items do not apply.

Each task is one coherent concern tied to specific REQs/ACs. No Done When list exceeds eight items. The 'Planned Files' lists are broad but the diffs are restricted to named behavior under 'Scope boundaries'. No fragmentation: the smallest task, T-003, covers a multi-file generated-projection registration.
The ACs include extensive negative and error-path tests: TEST-002, TEST-003a-c, TEST-005a-h, TEST-008a-d, TEST-010a-b, TEST-012a-d and TEST-013.

The tasks declare no unit/integration/E2E labels. Every referenced test is an AC-bound check (AC-001..AC-006) whose scope matches its assertion, e.g. TEST-004 is a multi-component launch-admission fixture and TEST-011a-f are per-entrypoint permission checks.

The 'Rollback for every task' section applies to all tasks: base revision and before-hash inventory, restoration in a disposable checkout, and executed results recorded. Each Done When also requires a disposable rollback test. T-004 adds a combined revert test.

Shared files (launch-impl-review.py, preflight-host-review.py, validate-review-context-set.*, tests/unified-task-launch.tests.py, tests/host-review-preflight.tests.py) appear in several tasks. Every pair is ordered by Blockers (T-001 -> T-005 -> T-002 -> T-003 -> T-004) with explicit release and serialization rules in 'Scope boundaries', so there is no uncoordinated overlap.

T-005 on T-001, T-002 on T-005 and T-004 on all others reflect shared-file or output dependencies. T-003 -> T-002 has no shared planned files and looks like pure serialization, but the tasks file declares one-owner serialization of shared edits and reservations in the stated execution order. Advisory only, not blocking.
SKIP: no bugfix or debugging task in scope. The tasks complete approved features and require RED-to-GREEN regression evidence regardless.
